title: Valentine’s Day
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this Valentine's Day episode, the Scranton office celebrates with humorous and heartfelt moments. Pam fondly recalls Jim's funny Valentine's card from last year, while Phyllis receives lavish gifts from Bob Vance. Michael travels to New York for a business presentation to the new CFO, navigating tensions involving Jan and his past with her. Meanwhile, Jim is single and plans a low-key evening with friends, Kelly excitedly shares her hookup with Ryan, and Dwight contemplates Valentine's gifts for his girlfriend. The episode culminates with Jan and Michael sharing a kiss amid worries about job security and misunderstandings with the CFO.
